standard_prerequisites.name: Permanence of universal homeomorphisms under composition; universal homeomorphisms are integral and universally injective with purely inseparable residue extensions

core_obligations: By the Frobenius lemma the absolute Frobenius F_X : X -> X and the base change h : X^{(p)} -> X of F_S are universal homeomorphisms (proof lines 7125-7134).

The identity h  circ  F_{X/S} = F_X holds by construction of the relative Frobenius; since h is a universal homeomorphism and F_X is one, so is F_{X/S} (permanence-universal-homeomorphism) (proof lines 7125-7134).

The integrality of F_{X/S} and the purely inseparable residue field extensions follow from the universal homeomorphism lemmas (universal-homeomorphism and universally-injective) (proof lines 7125-7134).
proof_roadmap: Factor the absolute Frobenius through the relative one and the base change, and read off the three properties from permanence lemmas.
difficulty_reason: The proof factors F_X = h  circ  F_{X/S} with h the base change of F_S, observes both F_X and h are universal homeomorphisms by the absolute Frobenius lemma, and concludes universal homeomorphism by permanence, then the integrality and purely inseparable residue field statements by two further Morphisms lemmas. H2: a three-lemma composition whose load-bearing identity h  circ  F_{X/S} = F_X and the correct application of permanence are the content.
